summary: Frontend-only regression for Vercel-readiness batch. On /contact: desktop nav-contact-cta and mobile mobile-nav-contact both carry aria-current='page'; on /about the Contact links do NOT carry aria-current while nav-about / mobile-nav-about do (bidirectional check passed). Canonical + og:url on 11 routes (/, /services, /tmms, /demonstrations, /about, /insights, /insights/what-is-a-cmms, /insights/reactive-vs-preventive-maintenance, /contact, /privacy, /cookies) all equal the exact https://www.nachieng.co.uk<path> URL. og:image on both articles begins with https://www.nachieng.co.uk/brand/og-. robots.txt served 200 text/plain (Cloudflare preamble prepended by preview proxy as expected; our required lines 'Disallow: /brand-preview', 'Disallow: /tmms/demos/', and 'Sitemap: https://www.nachieng.co.uk/sitemap.xml' all present after preamble). sitemap.xml served 200 application/xml, contains all 11 www URLs, no /brand-preview or /tmms/demos. Axe-core 4.10.2 (wcag2a,wcag2aa,wcag21a,wcag21aa,wcag22aa) on / and /contact at desktop and mobile => 0 violations. Forbidden terms scan on /, /contact, /about => none. Enquiries remained OFF (not exercised). Nothing to fix.
